arguments.message: When you create a record, the browse view shows the live data immediately, but the search feature works against an index that is refreshed a short time after the record is created. Under normal load this indexing can lag by a few minutes, so a newly‑created record may not appear in search right away even though you can see it by browsing. Usually the record shows up in search within a couple of minutes without any action needed. If it still isn’t searchable after several minutes, that’s not normal and you should report it for further investigation.
